d: It's Christmas Eve, and Alex makes a surprise return from Argentina to visit Stevie.
The car accident has thrown everyone off balance. Kate is obsessed with proving Riley survived.
Grace and Marcus are trapped at the bottom of an abandoned mine shaft.
Stevie's wild-at-heart former rodeo mate, Sharon, visits Drovers Run and turns everyone's lives upside down.
Kate is finishing her pipe project, she comes across a young runaway, Jamie, broken down on the stock route.
There seems to be an intruder haunting Drovers and Moira is spooked by strange noises in the night.
Alex returns from Argentina and his reunion with Stevie begins blissfully.
Stevie decides to leave Drovers Run and move to Killarney to secure her son's future.
Jaz returns to Drovers Run and clashes with Grace, leaving Regan stuck playing the role of peacemaker.
The girls of Drovers Run band together with the local community to stop a massive dam being built upstream.
Tayler and Patrick's happy domesticity is disrupted when Tayler's mother, Jane, returns.
Grace, Jaz, Marcus, and Frank go to the city to confront the Minister responsible for a dam proposal.
Jaz is taken aback when Lily reveals her dad, Frank, is talking about proposing to her.
The district Yard Dog trials are fast approaching when Ben is befriended by a border collie.
Jaz is surprised to discover her horse has been personally delivered by Mischa.
Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme, Grace threatens to report him to the officials.
Repercussions occur when, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler digs up gossip about him.
Grace discovers some of the new cattle have been stolen, Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.
Ingrid's husband Paul is investigating the cattle theft, and Phil has planned a special evening for Moira.
After being shot, Ingrid's husband Paul is determined to get his wife and nobody will stand in his way.
Rehearsals are in full swing as Moira prepares to play the leading girl in Phil's musical.

st: Into the Valley of the Shadow
d: Hit hard by the drought and facing a growing debt, the very future of Drovers Run is at stake.
With the land of Drovers Run on the line, Stevie musters all her determination to do the impossible.
Half-sisters Tess and Claire are reunited when they take over the family ranch after their father's death.
It's shearing time and one of the men arrives with a reputation as a killer.
Jealousies arise as Claire competes in the rodeo while Nick and Alex compete for Tess's attention.
Claire buys a pen of undernourished sheep from the stock sales, leaving Tess to question her judgment.
Tess's confidence is shaken after she falls from her horse.
Tess learns that Drovers Run is mired in debt and she confronts Claire.
Claire must pay off a debt to Harry Ryan, who has his eye on Drovers Run.
When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help.
The hunt for a boar that is threatening the livestock disrupts life and throws Tess's skills into question.
Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run.
Meg struggles to cope with the reality of JodI’s coming of age.
Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light.
Claire and Tess save a neighbour from a burning shed, but all is not as it seems.
Theft is on everyone’s mind and the women on Drover’s Run have their own style of justice.
When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run.
The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality.
The girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.
Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex.
When a good-looking itinerant Italian rescues Jodi from a rampant steer she falls hopelessly in love with him.
Tess believes she can discover the real reason behind everybody’s behaviour.
Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit.
Jodi is in the final stages of arranging a charity polo match.
Peter check on Claire's progress training the quarter horses, and their flirtation takes a new turn.
Tess and Alex's relationship is put to the test when a baby is abandoned on his doorstep.
Becky is thrown from her horse and injured when someone takes a shot at her.
It's a dry spell and the women are suffering shared baths, stained washing, and unflushed toilets.
Meg is thrown into turmoil when her first love, ex-husband Kevin (Jodi’s father) returns after 18 years.
Meg is faced with the decision to stay in the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.
Claire and Peter's growing relationship is leaving Tess feeling more and more isolated from her sister.
Claire and Peter move closer to marriage when he presents her with a ruby pendant.
Claire's relationships are fragmented.

st: Home is Where the Heart Is
d: Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly.
Becky's troublesome older brother Mark returns, determined to drag Sean into his life of illegality.
Frank Da Costa, the new cop in town, has it in for Terry.
With the drought continuing and no money to truck in water, Claire, Tess, and Nick join forces.
Tess motivates Claire into rekindling her dreams of becoming a stock horse trainer and breeder.

st: You Can Leave Your Hat On
d: Claire and Alex’s business gets off to a rocky start, whilst Nick and Tess form a partnership of their own.
Thieves clean out both Drovers Run and Wilgul, exposing some of the fault lines in the women’s relationships.
Romance is in the air for Jodi as Alberto returns, but Homestay guests bring problems for Tess.
Claire and Alex turns ugly when Peter starts circulating rumours about a secret in Alex’s past.
Claire has to deal with cattle theft and an old adversary.
Tess is on the brink of committing to Nick.
Claire and Tess are shocked to learn Drovers Run is being repossessed, but there’s a greater surprise to come.
Peter puts an astonishing proposition to Claire which will change her life forever.
Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital.
Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted.
Jodi is busy making plans for a big wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances.
Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man.
As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere.
With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly.
Becky senses mystery about Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves.

st: The Ghost of Things to Come
d: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother.
The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary gets shattered.
Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse.
Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run.
Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions.
The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex.
When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately.
Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend.
Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run.
A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter.
Claire's having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends & family when Peter arrives.
Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in ‘Pride and Prejudice'.
Becky's loyalties are tested when she and Jake establish a horse breeding business at Drovers Run.
Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down.
Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne.
At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day.
Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife.
It's the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered.
Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.
Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests.
Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way.
Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come up when a private investigator arrives.
Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work and wants to assure Charlotte's future.
Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her.
Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake.
Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run.
Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol.
Tess finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave.
Nick and Tess's relationship is further tested.
Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney.
Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte.
An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess.
Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through.
When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help.
Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run.
Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life.
